mapper.insert: INSERT INTO items (name, safety_stock_qty, target_stock_qty, standard_batch_qty, shelf_life_days) VALUES (#{name}, #{safetyStockQty}, #{targetStockQty}, #{standardBatchQty}, #{shelfLifeDays})
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, name, safety_stock_qty, target_stock_qty, standard_batch_qty, shelf_life_days, created_at, updated_at FROM items WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT item_id, name, safety_stock_qty, target_stock_qty, standard_batch_qty, shelf_life_days, created_at, updated_at FROM items ORDER BY item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE items SET name = #{name}, safety_stock_qty = #{safetyStockQty}, target_stock_qty = #{targetStockQty}, standard_batch_qty = #{standardBatchQty}, shelf_life_days = #{shelfLifeDays} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
